header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ Dispatches Groups to Give Da'wah

blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ Dispatches Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) to Yemen

Hadhrat Baraa bin Aazib (RA) narrates that he was among the group that Rasulullaah ﷺ dispatched to Yemen under the leadership of Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) to invite the people of Yemen to Islaam. They stayed there for six months but no one was prepared to accept Islaam. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ sent Hadhrat Ali (RA) with instructions to relieve Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) and to send him back with his men except those who preferred to remain behind with Hadhrat Ali (RA).
Hadhrat Baraa bin Aazib (RA) narrates that he was one of those who remained behind with Hadhrat Ali (RA). When Hadhrat Ali (RA) and the Muslims drew close to the people of Yemen, they also marched forward to meet the Muslims. Hadhrat Ali (RA) then stepped forward and led the Muslims in salaah. Thereafter, he formed the Muslims into a single row, stepped forward in front of the Muslims and read out the letter that Rasulullaah ﷺ had written. In response to this, the entire Hamdaan tribe accepted Islaam. Hadhrat Ali (RA) then wrote to Rasulullaah ﷺ to inform him that the Hamdaan tribe had accepted Islaam. When Rasulullaah ﷺ read the letter, he fell into Sajdah and then lifted his head and prayed, "Peace be to the Hamdaan! Peace be to the Hamdaan!" [^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Dispatches Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) to Najraan

Ibn Is'haaq narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once dispatched Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) to Najraan with instructions to invite the Banu Haarith bin Ka'b to Islaam for three days before engaging them in battle. Rasulullaah ﷺ told him that if the people accept Islaam, he should accept it from them, otherwise he should commence battle proceedings. Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) left Madinah and when he arrived in Najraan, he sent riders in every direction to meet the people and invite them to Islaam saying, "O people! Acept Islaam and remain in peace." Consequently, all the people accepted Islaam and entered the Deen they had been invited towards. Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) stayed with the people to teach them Islaam, the Qur'aan and the Sunnah of Rasulullaah ﷺ according to the directives that Rasulullaah ﷺ had given to him in the event that the people accepted Islaam without fighting. Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) the wrote the following letter Rasulullaah ﷺ:
The Letter Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) Sent to Rasulullaah ﷺ

In the name of Allaah the Most Kind, the Most Merciful
To Muhammad the Nabi and Rasool of Allaah ﷺ
Bayhaqi. Bukhari has also narrated it in brief as mentioned in Al Bidaaya wan Nihaaya (Vol.105 Pg.5).
